result.analyst_notes: Aspirational and belief-driven, with repeated 'We believe' framing and first-person plural voice. Innovation and technology as force for good dominate. Commitments are hedged ('working to', 'striving to'), not absolute. COVID section is concrete and addresses employees and communities. Shareholders, governance and environmental goals are largely absent.
